title: NRF closes HTTP socket if any unregistered NF sends Heartbeat and then Registration request

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

body:
Hi @acetcom ,

I was testing open5gs NRF with our NFs and noticed below problem. 
Our desing is like this, if we get 404 response for our Heartbeat requests, our NFs send NRF Registration PUT request in order to register to NRF. While our NFs are up and running, I restarted NRF so NRF cache is empty and then our NF send Heartbeat Request in this case your NRF prints below error and your HTTP socket became unavaible. After sometime NRF crashes and core dumped.
